$comment: Raw blind card, rater A, immutable once written. Criterion + probes archived before axes in scratchpad/8cf9050-blind-a/evidence.md; ledger in scratchpad/8cf9050-blind-a/ledger.txt.
evaluator: blind-a (agent rater, seed 269, headed GPU D3D12 RTX 3080, 400x800 @3x)

horizon.exclusions: driver/selector errors and retries (one 30 s locator timeout), page reloads for absences, ledger writing; card writing after 16:41:50 excluded
horizon.runsWatchedNote: 12 runs sent while present, all observed at least partly; about 22 min at 1x normal across runs 4, 5, 6, 7 and the D1-4 start of run 10; the rest at fights-only
horizon.ruleEditsNote: pen unlocked after the first death; kept: hp<50 drink unknown (later hp<20 read unknown), foe: undead -> throw fire, has: leash -> tame nearest, foe: boss -> read silence (+ depth>=28); dropped: foe: gas -> attack gas/retreat
horizon.blindnessViolations: read only the idle-hybrid weights block of eval/presets.json to zero a weight-0 axis as the brief instructs; saw the other rater's card filename in a directory listing but did not open it

sameDayRetelling: After my first heir died to Bloat Mother gas at D13, I wrote my first rule: drink unknown potions under half health. Una Ash took that rule down, drank a strength potion when hurt, and found her father's bones ('Found heir 1's bones: 10 items') on the floor where he fell. She went on through the bloat mother and the lich and starved down to 36 max hp, and still banked $10177 at a record D21.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: The forecast ('FLOOR CHANCE D9 88% · killer: gas · death 38%') and the per-edit 'VS LAST RUN · full haul 25→63%' preview kept the goal and the effect of a choice visible. But the 'Warlord tactic' button opened a sheet with no warlord tactic, the King death said 'hero at 18 hp' over a trace ending '0/50', and quest/breed taps gave no visible result.

Real trade-offs existed, and some bit me: my 'foe: boss → read silence' spent the only scroll on the D8 warlord ('D8 · silence scroll · silent'), so I added 'depth ≥ 28'. But many picks were just taking the option labeled 'better 8/8' / 'better 6/8', and at the King the TRY advice flipped between boss focus and Mirror rhythm.

I learned to read counter lines ('QUEEN · REGENERATING · COUNTER: READ SILENCE') and answer them with a supply and a rule, then saw 'first: Queen slain'. The King wall ('none beats 0/12 as is') offered no next thing I could learn inside the horizon.

Carry at risk is visible and real ('Carried $668 · Secured past D13 · Heading home' at 10/32 hp, then '$668 lost'). Most of the stakes resolved offline, though, and read as tallies ('4 RUNS · 4 died · lost $5512').

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Hand control answers instantly ('attack' → 'Dara Ash → jackal · −14 hp · jackal · fell'), and boss callouts land ('BLOAT MOTHER DOWN'). At 1x a fresh run spends about a minute on D1–D4 pickups. Audio unassessed (agent cannot listen).

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: Each of these changed what I configured: the hero fighting his own tamed golem ('Dara Ash → Skak · −16 hp'), my unknown-potion rule killing an heir ('Gambled: poison potion'), 'Found heir 1's bones', and hunger shrinking max hp ('starving −43'). Lapse: the D8 warlord / D13 mother opening repeated every run.

The hero's title tracked my picks ('Guarded slayer' → 'Bulwark' → 'Guarded prowler'), and four of my own rows sat above the packages ('has: leash → tame nearest'). But the report said my rules were 'taught 1–3%' against 'chores 64–74%', so the build is mostly offered packages.

The reel and grudges make turns: 'grudge: Ashog the lurker', 'avenged Morix', 'Queen cornered him to 9 HP; held the corridor; banked $2510.', 'Found heir 1's bones'. Lapse: offline deaths arrive as one-line reels, not experienced turns.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: Check-ins of 5 to 20 minutes always ended on a send. Fights-only watching and 'D9–12 · 100% · +$334' skips moved well. But each check-in needed 5 to 10 sheet taps (forge, legacy, tactics, workers, supplies, unlocks), and fresh 1x runs drag on D1–D4.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: One screen gives cause, margin and rule: 'gas · D13 · hero at 3 hp · 9/12 replays survive · fixes: hp < 40% → drink unknown survives 12/12', and 'own poison · drink unknown at 50%'. Lapse: the King header hp contradicts the trace, and its TRY suggestion ping-pongs.
Weight 0 in idle-hybrid. Named heirs and pets only; no relationship develops.
Route forks ('fens → D13 or crypt · untried'), optional hand control ('Hand control · awaits order') and self-chosen taming were mine to take. Goals were otherwise the fixed next record ('Goal D34').

All three layers were observed. Within a run: depth and carry. Persistent: 'best D6 → D13 → D21 → D28 → D33', forge, legacy ranks, new tactics each report. Automation: scout 'SEND auto', porter, apprentice, drillmaster ('boss focus L5'). Lapse: hunger never got a visible answer, and the apprentice's '−$10000 forge' was a surprise drain.

A torch-lit pixel village around a campfire, banner death screens with boss portraits, and dungeon palettes that change by lane (fens blue, foundry red). Lapse: yellow-on-parchment 'Bulwark held D20' is barely legible, and 'best D6' / 'reputation' and damage numbers over chips overlap. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: offline yield vs active; decisions pending on return
axes.note: Every return had things to read and choose: 'While away · 4 RUNS · 4 died · D28 · Foundry Master defeated', a 'Pick one' (drill / legacy / forge −30%), 'New choices', deaths with verdicts and 'Queen weakness learned · read silence'. It scaled with absence. Lapse: the 20m return was thin (1 run, one pick).

axes.proxy: share of deaths attributable to a rule the player wrote
axes.note: I can name which of my rows did what: 'own poison · drink unknown at 50%' killed heir 6, 'D12 · throw fire wraith' and 'Krak · pet' came from my rows, and my silence row wasted a scroll at D8. Lapse: in the first 15 minutes and in offline deaths, the decisive rows were packages ('taught 1%').
